policyCorpus.title: Regular Attendance & Hours Completion Mandate
policyCorpus.verbatimText: Higher Education Institutions (HEIs) through the SIPP Coordinator shall strictly monitor student intern attendance and punctuality. Accumulated unexcused absences exceeding three (3) consecutive working days or a cumulative training hours deficit exceeding fifteen percent (15%) of the scheduled Training Plan pace shall require immediate written explanation and a mandatory case conference with the Host Training Establishment (HTE) supervisor.

policyCorpus.sectionRef: Part IV, Section 4.3.2 (OJT Attendance & Progressive Intervention)
policyCorpus.title: Disciplinary Protocol for Unexcused OJT Absences
policyCorpus.verbatimText: Student interns deployed to partner Host Training Establishments must log daily time records accurately. Incurring more than three (3) consecutive unexcused absences or falling behind the college-prescribed OJT hour quota pace by more than 15% constitutes a Level 1 Academic Internship Infringement, triggering an official Early-Warning Advisory and a remedial catch-up schedule signed by the College OJT Coordinator.

policyCorpus.sectionRef: Article V, Section 10.2 & Article VI, Section 14.3 (Training Plan Alignment)
policyCorpus.title: Prohibition of Non-Academic Clerical & Menial Errands
policyCorpus.verbatimText: The Host Training Establishment (HTE) shall provide practical training strictly aligned with the student intern’s degree program competencies as stipulated in the approved Internship Training Plan. Assigning student interns predominantly to non-academic clerical tasks, personal errands, or menial duties unrelated to their discipline across consecutive reporting weeks is strictly prohibited and warrants immediate coordinator realignment with the HTE supervisor.

policyCorpus.sectionRef: Part IV, Section 4.5.1 (Competency Alignment & Reassignment Safeguards)
policyCorpus.title: Protection Against Non-Degree Task Assignment
policyCorpus.verbatimText: Weekly accomplishment reports submitted by the intern must demonstrate progressive acquisition of program outcomes. If three (3) consecutive weekly logs reflect predominantly non-degree clerical or messengerial work, the OJT Coordinator shall initiate a consultative review with the HTE Supervisor to realign the student’s workstation tasks or facilitate reassignment if misalignment persists.

policyCorpus.title: Mandatory Documentary Prerequisites Prior to Deployment
policyCorpus.verbatimText: No student intern shall be permitted to commence or continue on-site deployment at a Host Training Establishment without complete, verified documentary requirements on file: (1) Medical Clearance Certificate, (2) Psychological Assessment Report, (3) Notarized Parent/Guardian Consent and Waiver, (4) Valid OJT Accident Insurance Policy, and (5) Executed Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) and Endorsement Letter.

policyCorpus.sectionRef: Part IV, Section 4.1.4 (Hold-Deployment & Compliance Cure Period)
policyCorpus.title: Post-Deployment Documentation Deficit Cure Notice
policyCorpus.verbatimText: Interns whose pre-deployment documentary folders contain unverified or returned items past the official deployment date shall be issued a Documentation Deficit Notice. The intern is granted a five (5) working-day cure period to upload verified copies; failure to comply results in temporary suspension of DTR credit accumulation until full documentary compliance is certified.
